name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior precious metals company focused on gold and silver exploration, royalty acquisition, and streaming in Nevada and Idaho. Its flagship Lapon Canyon Gold Project near Yerington, Nevada, returned intercepts of 3.97 g/t Au over 85 metres in early 2026, with a follow-up drill program launched in June 2026. The company operates a three-part strategy combining royalty creation, streaming, and an exploration project accelerator.
